verdict.rationale: Docs show explicit fleet-management capabilities: registering readers via serial number, registration code, or order number (docs-5, docs-20, docs-43), organizing readers by locations/zones across sites (docs-4), and a Dashboard/API 'Reader management' feature to order, register, configure, and monitor readers (docs-32). API-based integration is explicitly supported alongside SDKs (docs-1, docs-18), and Connect integration allows platform-level fleet control (docs-11, docs-12). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer account of using the Fleet API specifically (community evidence only discusses payment integration, not device fleet ops), and no explicit example of remote firmware/config push via API beyond docs claims.
